source: public: Okta support-system session-token theft, Oct 2023

input.description: An admin session token from an uploaded HAR file was replayed from a new ASN; the session performed privileged reads across multiple tenants.
signals: okta system log: session reused from new ASN/geo

labels.rationale_for_label: Stolen session token replayed by an external actor — a confirmed identity compromise, high (not critical: scoped to support-portal reads).
